Welcome to DragonRuby Socket Extension docs

docs.text: Client see main.rb for a working example including most of the following features client = Client.new() client.connect("localhost", 6789) event = client.next_event client.send(event.peer, {data: {message: "ping"}}) connected = client.connected? def tick args if args.state.tick_count == 0 $client = Client.new() $client.connect("localhost", 6789) end event = $client.next_event while event if event.type == :s_event_receive puts("Got message: #{event.data}.") elsif event.type == :s_event_connect puts("connected.") elsif event.type == :s_event_disconnect puts("disconnected.") end event = $client.next_event end end
